meta.name: AiMY Customer Catalogue
meta.purpose: Customer-facing pitch asset for AiMY support and sales operations
meta.audience: Sales teams, customer stakeholders, implementation sponsors
sourceNarratives: AiMY L1 Support — Client Onboarding Journey
meta.securityModel: Public UI contains no internal issue keys, internal URLs, ownership fields, internal labels, or raw ticket summaries. Release data is translated into customer-safe capability themes.

tracks.name: AiMY L1 Support
tracks.tagline: Turn reactive support into a self-improving operating system.
day0: Knowledge is scattered across drives, wikis, chat threads, and senior agents' heads.
QA is manual, selective, and late, so most conversations are never reviewed.
Voice interactions are hard to monitor, search, and feed back into process improvement.
Supervisors react to escalations instead of seeing risk early.
day30: Agents work from one consistent knowledge layer.
Text and voice channels are covered by the same intelligence layer.
Conversation QA becomes continuous instead of sampled.
Knowledge gaps turn into reviewed improvement actions.

tracks.name: AiMY Sales
tracks.tagline: Make outreach, pipeline visibility, and sales learning repeatable.
day0: Pipeline visibility depends on CRM data quality and rep follow-up.
Outreach varies by rep, creating inconsistent messaging and follow-up cadence.
Product knowledge and proof points are scattered across systems.
Managers spend too much time chasing updates and not enough time coaching.
journey: Manager mode for queryable pipeline visibility
day30: Every rep works from the same product knowledge and playbooks.
Outreach becomes consistent, grounded, and repeatable.
Pipeline risk and activity are easier to query and act on.
Managers coach from evidence instead of chasing manual updates.
Win/loss patterns feed back into future playbooks and outreach guidance.

modules.name: AiMY Knowledge
modules.oneLiner: A unified knowledge layer that grounds AiMY answers in your real content.
modules.problem: Teams lose time hunting for the right answer, policy, case study, or process note.
modules.whatItDoes: Connects to approved knowledge sources and gives agents or reps fast, consistent, contextual answers.
modules.outcome: A single operating baseline: fewer guessed answers, faster ramp-up, and more consistent customer conversations.

features.shortDescription: Securely connects to your existing help content — SOPs, manuals, FAQs, and playbooks — and turns it into one verified, searchable knowledge layer.
features.customerProblem: Knowledge is scattered across drives, wikis, chat threads, and senior agents' heads, so answers are inconsistent and slow.
features.customerValue: A single source of truth that both support agents and sales reps can trust from day one.
features.whatChanged: Released the ingestion and indexing layer that grounds every AiMY answer in your real, approved content.
features.description: Securely connects to your existing help content — SOPs, manuals, FAQs, and playbooks — and turns it into one verified, searchable knowledge layer.
features.customer_value: A single source of truth that both support agents and sales reps can trust from day one.

features.shortDescription: A natural-language console that gives agents and reps fast, contextual answers drawn only from your verified knowledge.
features.customerProblem: Agents lose time hunting for the right policy or answer and often guess, creating inconsistent customer conversations.
features.customerValue: Faster handle times and consistent answers, regardless of who is on shift.
features.whatChanged: Released the conversational answer experience built on the verified knowledge layer.
features.description: A natural-language console that gives agents and reps fast, contextual answers drawn only from your verified knowledge.
features.customer_value: Faster handle times and consistent answers, regardless of who is on shift.

features.shortDescription: Controls who can see and manage knowledge, entities, and permissions across teams.
features.customerProblem: Without clear access controls, sensitive content and admin settings are hard to govern as teams grow.
features.customerValue: Confident, governed rollout across departments without exposing the wrong content to the wrong people.
features.whatChanged: Released user, role, and permission management for the knowledge platform.
features.description: Controls who can see and manage knowledge, entities, and permissions across teams.
features.customer_value: Confident, governed rollout across departments without exposing the wrong content to the wrong people.

features.shortDescription: Answers can include live, clickable links and contactable actions so agents move from answer to action in one step.
features.customerProblem: Static answers still leave agents copying references and switching tabs to act on them.
features.customerValue: Less context-switching and faster resolution from a single answer surface.
features.whatChanged: Released contactable hyperlinks across the platform.
features.description: Answers can include live, clickable links and contactable actions so agents move from answer to action in one step.
features.customer_value: Less context-switching and faster resolution from a single answer surface.

features.shortDescription: Two-way connection with Zendesk so AiMY works inside your existing helpdesk.
features.customerProblem: Bolt-on tools that don't sync with the helpdesk create double work and stale data.
features.customerValue: AiMY fits into the tools your team already uses, with no rip-and-replace.
features.whatChanged: Released Zendesk sync.
features.description: Two-way connection with Zendesk so AiMY works inside your existing helpdesk.
features.customer_value: AiMY fits into the tools your team already uses, with no rip-and-replace.

features.shortDescription: Connects AiMY to your existing support stack so interactions flow in automatically.
features.customerProblem: Manual exports and disconnected systems slow onboarding and leave gaps in coverage.
features.customerValue: Plug-and-play setup that connects your existing ticketing to AiMY.
features.whatChanged: Building Zendesk and Freshdesk integrations.
features.description: Connects AiMY to your existing support stack so interactions flow in automatically.
features.customer_value: Plug-and-play setup that connects your existing ticketing to AiMY.

modules.name: AiMY Voice
modules.oneLiner: Turns calls into searchable, coachable, structured operational data.
modules.problem: Voice conversations are usually a black box, even though they contain the richest customer signals.
modules.whatItDoes: Captures call context, supports live assistance, and feeds transcripts and outcomes into QA, knowledge, and follow-up workflows.
modules.outcome: Calls stop disappearing after they end; they become part of the same improvement loop as tickets and chats.

features.shortDescription: Brings phone calls into the same intelligence layer as chat and tickets, so voice stops being a black box.
features.customerProblem: Voice conversations are hard to monitor, search, and feed back into improvement, even though they hold the richest signals.
features.customerValue: Calls become searchable, coachable operational data instead of disappearing after they end.
features.whatChanged: Released the calls integration that connects voice interactions to AiMY.
features.description: Brings phone calls into the same intelligence layer as chat and tickets, so voice stops being a black box.
features.customer_value: Calls become searchable, coachable operational data instead of disappearing after they end.

features.shortDescription: Enterprise-grade inbound and outbound calling built natively into AiMY.
features.customerProblem: Stitching telephony to support tooling is fragile and leaves gaps in coverage.
features.customerValue: A reliable voice foundation that the rest of the improvement loop can build on.
features.whatChanged: Building native voice infrastructure for inbound and outbound calls.
features.description: Enterprise-grade inbound and outbound calling built natively into AiMY.
features.customer_value: A reliable voice foundation that the rest of the improvement loop can build on.

features.shortDescription: A live call screen that shows transcription and matching knowledge side-by-side while an agent is on a call.
features.customerProblem: Agents handle calls without real-time support, so quality depends on memory and tenure.
features.customerValue: Real-time guidance that lifts first-call resolution and consistency.
features.whatChanged: Designing the active call experience with live assist.
features.description: A live call screen that shows transcription and matching knowledge side-by-side while an agent is on a call.
features.customer_value: Real-time guidance that lifts first-call resolution and consistency.

features.shortDescription: Turns finished calls into structured summaries, outcomes, and follow-up actions automatically.
features.customerProblem: After a call ends, its value is usually lost to manual notes or nothing at all.
features.customerValue: Every call feeds QA, knowledge, and follow-up without manual write-up.
features.whatChanged: Building post-call summarisation and follow-up actions.
features.description: Turns finished calls into structured summaries, outcomes, and follow-up actions automatically.
features.customer_value: Every call feeds QA, knowledge, and follow-up without manual write-up.

modules.name: AiMY QA
modules.oneLiner: Continuous QA coverage across support conversations.
modules.problem: Manual QA reviews a sample, catches issues late, and misses recurring patterns.
modules.whatItDoes: Analyses interactions against quality standards, flags risks, and turns repeated failures into coaching and knowledge signals.
modules.outcome: Quality becomes a live signal instead of a delayed audit process.

features.shortDescription: Evaluates support interactions against your quality standards instead of reviewing a small manual sample.
features.customerProblem: Manual QA reviews a fraction of conversations, catches issues late, and misses recurring patterns.
features.customerValue: Quality becomes a live signal with far broader coverage than manual sampling.
features.whatChanged: Released the QA v1 evaluation platform.
features.description: Evaluates support interactions against your quality standards instead of reviewing a small manual sample.
features.customer_value: Quality becomes a live signal with far broader coverage than manual sampling.

features.shortDescription: Upload and evaluate large volumes of calls at once so historical and high-volume operations are fully covered.
features.customerProblem: High call volumes make it impossible to review conversations one at a time.
features.customerValue: QA keeps pace with real operational volume instead of falling behind.
features.whatChanged: Released bulk call uploads and large-call handling.
features.description: Upload and evaluate large volumes of calls at once so historical and high-volume operations are fully covered.
features.customer_value: QA keeps pace with real operational volume instead of falling behind.

features.shortDescription: Turns QA results into clear charts and conversational insights so leaders can see patterns, not just scores.
features.customerProblem: Raw QA scores are hard to act on without seeing trends and drivers.

features.customer_value: Leaders spot recurring issues and coaching opportunities at a glance.

features.shortDescription: A structured workflow for agents to dispute QA outcomes and for leads to resolve them fairly.

features.customer_value: Fair, transparent QA that teams actually trust and adopt.

features.shortDescription: Next-generation evaluation that scores tone, accuracy, and compliance across every interaction.
features.customerProblem: Consistent, compliance-aware scoring is hard to achieve manually at scale.
features.customerValue: Critical risks and tone issues are flagged within minutes of a conversation closing.

features.description: Next-generation evaluation that scores tone, accuracy, and compliance across every interaction.
features.customer_value: Critical risks and tone issues are flagged within minutes of a conversation closing.

modules.whatItDoes: Brings operational signals together so supervisors can see performance, queue pressure, escalation patterns, and coaching needs.
modules.outcome: Supervisors move from firefighting to proactive operations management.
